name: Mercury abort handle
view: the left armrest of the couch from above, as the astronaut sees it at the left hand; forward is up: the abort handle standing on its bracket at the front of the armrest; pulled to fire the escape tower
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the handle and bracket reconstructed from the public Mercury spacecraft descriptions (NASA Project Mercury familiarization manual overview, Smithsonian museum descriptions, Wikipedia) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
